summary: Domain otravelz.in has no registered DNS A, AAAA, or CNAME records at any public recursive resolver.

operator_action_checklist.title: Verify Registrar Ownership
operator_action_checklist.instruction: Log in to domain registrar (e.g. GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains/Squarespace) and verify active registration of otravelz.in.

operator_action_checklist.title: Configure Apex DNS for GitHub Pages
operator_action_checklist.instruction: Add the 4 official GitHub Pages A records to apex (otravelz.in): 185.199.108.153, 185.199.109.153, 185.199.110.153, 185.199.111.153.

operator_action_checklist.title: Configure WWW CNAME
operator_action_checklist.instruction: Add CNAME record for www.otravelz.in pointing to algoryxz.github.io.

operator_action_checklist.title: Configure API Subdomain
operator_action_checklist.instruction: Add CNAME record for api.otravelz.in pointing to the hosted backend target (e.g. otravelz-backend.onrender.com or custom proxy).

operator_action_checklist.title: Enable Custom Domain in GitHub Pages
operator_action_checklist.instruction: In Algoryxz/O-Travelz Settings -> Pages, enter Custom domain: otravelz.in and check Enforce HTTPS once DNS propagates.
